title: rhodiola fastigiata
intro: Rhodiola fastigiata, commonly known as Arctic rhodiola or golden root, is a species of flowering plant in the family Crassulaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress, improving mood, and enhancing physical performance. The therapeutic actions of Rhodiola fastigiata are attributed to its ability to adaptogenic, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to protect the body against the negative effects of stress. The bioactive constituents of Rhodiola fastigiata include rosavin, salidroside, and tyrosol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
